art_direction: Existing project SHADOW CROWN anatomy: the complete drow body is the head/front of a colossal spider of shadow, smoke and web; opaque bone-white chitin, silver hair, black-violet abdomen and eight legs. Owner clarified this existing reference; no new design.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one fullscreen ending comic panel for The First Nine. Image 1: existing comic panel/edit target. Eight companions, when shown, remain fully clothed and unchanged; no ninth companion or human duplicate of Nolf. Single transformation panel: replace the central humanoid Nolf and her old appendages with this giant unified drow-front shadow-spider creature, low broad shadow abdomen clearly visible behind the silver-haired drow front. Show eight shadow spider legs separated against the forest. Retain the dark forest, moon, lighting and quiet foreground. No other people or wagon.
assets.caption: Nolf's transformation was complete.
